name: com.aidancmays.cartography
description: Maps that reveal as you explore. Describe a place as regions (room footprints) on layers (storeys), with walls and points of interest; reveal around whoever walks it; draw any layer in UI as an inked, hand-printed map. Reveal state packs small enough to send to late joiners. Builds straight from a Masonry layout when Masonry is installed.
